project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 16 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 140 of 146 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.
